name: spice-frother-triangle-deepseek-v4.1-flash-s2-r1
caseTitle: ngspice: triangle-wave carrier for a milk frother
prompt: A milk frother's heater is driven by PWM, and the PWM needs a 1 kHz triangle-wave carrier of 2 V peak to peak. Build that oscillator in ngspice using only DC supplies, so the oscillation comes from the circuit itself, and simulate 20 ms. In a .control block, save the carrier voltage with wrdata to a .txt file so it can be plotted.

source.text:
* 1 kHz triangle-wave carrier, 2 V peak-to-peak, self-oscillating
* Only DC supplies are used; the oscillation comes from the circuit itself.
*
* Topology: an inverting integrator (E_int + R_int + C_int) is driven by a
* Schmitt-trigger comparator (B_cmp with positive feedback Ra/Rb).
* The comparator output swings between the DC rails (+/-12 V), and the
* feedback network sets the hysteresis thresholds to +/-1 V, so the
* integrator output (the carrier) is a 2 Vpp triangle.
*
* f = (Vsat) / (4 * Vth * R_int * C_int) = 12 / (4*1*30k*100n) = 1 kHz

* --- DC supplies ---
Vcc  vcc 0 DC  12
Vee  vee 0 DC -12

* --- Integrator (op-amp 1) ---
* ideal op-amp: V(tri) = -A*V(inv1)
E_int tri 0 0 inv1 100000
R_int comp inv1 30k
C_int tri inv1 100n ic=0.1
R_dc  tri inv1 1Meg          $ DC feedback path so the bias point exists

* --- Schmitt-trigger comparator (op-amp 2) ---
* saturating comparator: output is the +/-12 V rail span, soft-clipped
B_cmp comp 0 V = 0.5*(V(vcc)-V(vee))*tanh(1000*(V(p2)-V(n2)))
Rn2  n2  0  1
* positive feedback network: V+ = (12*V(tri) + V(comp))/13
Ra   tri p2 1k
Rb   comp p2 12k
Cp2  p2  0  1n

.control
tran 1u 20m uic
wrdata carrier.txt v(tri)
.endc
.end
